source: Rows: the community FreeRealms-Legacy server's point-of-interest table (AGPL-3.0, see NOTICE), the table the 2014 client accepts as message 57 (reader 00b98b70).
spawn/facing with a spawn_source are the original server's own 38/12 replies from preserved captures; every other spawn is the reference table's (community reconstruction).
Names are labels for chat lines and the admin move command; the client draws its own text from name_id.

rules.comment: (R) all reconstructed and tunable. attune_radius_m: a stone is found inside this planar distance of its row (the stone bodies stand up to 17 m from their rows). undiscovered: 'disabled' sends a stone not found yet as notification type 8 (the Atlas's greyed icon, no teleport), 'hidden' leaves it out.

points.name: Sunstone Valley (comic book)
points.spawn_source: (R) the client's sunstone comic teleports to id 153 (ScriptsBase ComicBook:TeleportPlayer); the reference row has no position, so it arrives at the Sunstone Valley warpstone
